user_input: Give me an example of sending Hubspot contact property that is updated only the first time.
model_output:
To send a HubSpot contact property that is updated only the first time, you can use the "Update Contact Property" action in Zapier. This action will trigger when a contact property is updated, and it will only send the property the first time it is updated.

For example, let's say you have a HubSpot form where people can sign up for your newsletter. When someone submits their email address, you want to add them to a Google Sheet with their email address and any other information they provided in the form. You can use the "Update Contact Property" action in Zapier to accomplish this.

When a new contact is added to HubSpot, the "Update Contact Property" action will trigger. It will then check if the contact's email address has been added to the Google Sheet before. If it has not, the action will add the email address to the sheet. If it has, the action will not add it again, so the contact's email address will only be added to the sheet the first time they sign up.
